sourceConflicts.exactQuote:
4 or more book scatters on the screen trigger 10 free games with a special expanding symbol. The special expanding symbol cannot be substituted by a scatter symbol during Free games.
One special expanding symbol is randomly selected at the start of the Free games. During Free Games and after the payout of regular symbols, the special symbol may expand to cover 3 positions on the reel and pays like the regular symbol, even on non-adjacent positions and on all lines played (expanding is only triggered if enough symbols for a win are present).
Every time a player hits 3 or more Book scatter symbols during Free games, they will win an extra 10 Free spins, and the expanding bonus symbol will remain the same.
Players can use the Buy Bonus Feature to buy the Free Games Round at a specified price.

sourceQuotes.text: The WILD symbol substitutes for all other symbols in winning combinations on active paylines. If a WILD symbol does not participate in a win, it remains on the grid and its multiplier increases by +1 on each new spin. When the WILD symbol forms part of a winning combination, the win is multiplied by its current multiplier value.

When a WILD symbol appears anywhere on the game grid and does not participate in a winning combination, the WILD symbol remains fixed in its position while a new spin is performed. The selected bet amount is deducted from the player's balance for each new spin. After each new spin in which the WILD symbol does not take part in a winning combination, its multiplier increases by +1 (for example, x2, x3, x4, and so on). Your accumulated WILD Multiplier is linked to your chosen bet value. If you change your bet, the current WILD Multiplier is saved and will reactivate whenever you switch back to that specific betting value. The WILD multiplier increases only when the WILD symbol does not participate in a winning combination. When the WILD symbol forms part of a winning combination, the win is paid and multiplied by the current WILD multiplier value. If a winning combination occurs without the participation of a WILD symbol, that win is paid normally. (According to the paytable). A new spin then follows, and the WILD multiplier increases if the WILD symbol again does not form part of a winning combination. Multiple WILD symbols may appear on the game grid at the same time. Any WILD symbol that participates in a winning combination is removed from the grid. WILD symbols that do not participate remain in place, and their multipliers increase by +1 on each new spin in which they do not form part of a winning combination.

By activating this feature, the bet amount is multiplied by 5, and each spin is played with this increased bet amount. When this bet is active, at least one 5X WILD symbol is guaranteed to appear on the very first spin. If this WILD symbol does not participate in a winning combination, its multiplier will increase by +1. If the same WILD symbol still does not participate in a winning combination on the next spin, its multiplier will increase by another +1, and so on, until that WILD symbol participates in a winning combination. During each new spin, if a new WILD symbol appears, its multiplier will always start at 5X, and the same rule described above will apply to it as well.If 2 WILD symbols participate in a winning combination, their multipliers are added together, and the payout for the winning line is calculated using the combined multiplier. The WILD symbol(s) that participate in a winning combination are removed from the game board. However, if there is another WILD symbol on the board that does not participate in a winning combination, it will remain on the game board. If the player stops playing or changes the bet, any existing WILD symbol or symbols and their multipliers from the already played ANTE BET will be saved. When the player returns to that specific ANTE BET, the saved WILD symbol or symbols will still be present in the game with their accumulated multipliers.The WILD symbol and its multiplier are saved only for the specific fixed ANTE BET on which they were accumulated. When the bet is changed, that WILD symbol and its multiplier will not carry over to another ANTE BET selection. The player can stop playing with ANTE BET at any time by pressing the Disable button. In this case, the base bet amount will return to the value it had before ANTE BET was activated.

sourceQuotes.text: In the game, players have the opportunity to double their winnings with the X2 Gamble Feature. After a winning spin, players can access the Gamble round by clicking the “X2” button. Once the gamble screen appears, a card in the middle of the screen will flash red and black while face down, indicating that the gamble feature is active. To double their winnings, players must correctly guess the color of the card that will be revealed next. If they succeed, their winnings will be doubled. However if the guess incorrectly, their original win will be lost. At any point, players can use the “Take Win” button to collect their winnings and add them to their main balance.

When you hit a winning combination, you have three options to credit the win amount to your balance: you can start a new spin by clicking the spin button, Use the take win button to transfer the win to your balance, or use the X2 Double up feature button and clickt take win. If you are playing in AutoPlay mode, all wins are automatically transferred to your balance.

Once the gamble screen appears, a card in the middle of the screen will flash red and black while face down, indicating that the gamble feature is active. To double their winnings, players must correctly guess the color of the card that will be revealed next. If they succeed, their winnings will be doubled. However if the guess incorrectly, their original win will be lost. At any point, players can use the “Take Win” button to collect their winnings and add them to their main balance. Limit :

sourceQuotes.text: Previous OTHER RULES 09 Game Objective: The goal is to win money by dropping Plinko X balls and waiting for them to randomly land on a multiplier slot at the bottom of the board. Fair Play: The speed, skill, or decision of the player does not influence or increase the chances of winning or define the outcome of the game. Outcomes are determined by a Random Number Generator (RNG). Bet Deduction: Each ball dropped will deduct its corresponding bet amount individually from your balance. For example, if the bet size is 1 DMO each ball dropped will cost 1 DMO from your balance. Malfunction Policy: In the event of a malfunction, all plays and payouts are void. All unfinished rounds will be terminated. If a disconnection occurs or the game is reloaded, all active bets and rounds will complete automatically, with winnings credited to your balance. Auto Play will be deactivated after disconnection. Variations in connection speed or device processing capabilities may impact, or appear to impact, overall game performance. RTP Information: The RTP is based on theoretical calculations and is not influenced by player behavior. Each multiplier determines the payout for that round. During the game, the panel on the left displays the multipliers won in each ball drop. The player's speed or skill does not influence or increase the chances of winning or determine the game outcome. Each ball dropped individually deducts the bet amount from your balance. KEY FEATURE: Colorful balls: With each click, one ball (1x, 5x, or10x) is randomly selected to drop onto the pyramid. Higher-value balls lead to bigger winnings at the end. Game Version: Choose from three volatility levels—Low, Medium, or High—offering different multiplier ranges. Quick Play: Drop 25 balls at once with a single click for faster gameplay. B+ Features: For 50% extra cost (not included in payouts), this feature increases the chance of landing higher-value balls (5x and 10x). Maximum payout potential is 10,000x when playing the High volatility version. This is achievable if a 10x ball lands in the 1,000x slot at the base of the pyramid, with this result occurring approximately once every 4,802,650 rounds. sourceQuotes.text: The bonus game feature triggers when 4 or more scatter symbols land anywhere on the screen. The round starts with 10 free spins. During the bonus round, players can receive extra multiplier symbols that can land anywhere on the screen. Multiplier symbols are present on the reels only during the bonus game and they remain on the screen until the end of the current spin. Whenever a multiplier symbol lands, it will take a random value of:2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, 6X, 7X, 8X, 9X, 10X, 12X, 15X, 18X, 20X, 25X, 30X, 40X, 50X, 60X, 80X, 90X or 100X. When the spin ends, the value of all multiplier symbols on the screen are added together and the total win of that round is multiplied by the final value.

During the bonus free spins, players can randomly trigger the Genie’s Carpet feature. During this feature, before the start of spin, the genie’s carpet will fly across the screen and drop 4 or more special ‘?’ cloud symbols. After the feature ends, the “?” symbols will turn into the same random pay symbols. Additionally, random multipliers can also appear under the “?”. At the end of this feature, a basic spin will start and fill the empty reels. Players can instantly start the bonus game using the ‘Bonus Buy’ button. This will cost 100x your base bet value.

sourceQuotes.text: The player has the option to select the bet multiplier. Depending on the selected bet, playing with B+ will always cost the player an extra 25% of their total bet. The added B+ value will not be taken into consideration when paying out on symbols, either in the basic or bonus game. The B+ feature allows players to collect scatters received only during the base game. If a player collects 100 scatters during the same round, the player will trigger a free bonus game. B+ bet also has the ‘Risk’ game feature, which means that as soon as a player reaches 10% of the progress bar, they can play the ‘Risk’ game. The Risk game chance depends on the percentage of the progress bar. When the Risk game is triggered, a wheel appears on the screen. Players can spin the wheel and if they hit a win, they will be awarded a Bonus game. If they hit a ‘lose’ they will return to the base game. After spinning the Risk game wheel, whether the player wins or loses, the progress bar will be reset.The cost of a Risk game spin is the same as the bet amount. If a player does not have enough money in their account, an error pop-up will appear asking them to add funds. After spinning the Risk game wheel, if the player loses, they will receive one extra spin in the base game. If the player wins the Risk game spin, they will receive a bonus winning spin in the base game. If a player lands 4 or more scatters during the base game at the same time, the Genies progress bar will increase to 100% and the player will play 2 bonus games. The first will start automatically and after this, the second game begins. By default, at the start of the game, the B+ button is always activated. If you choose to switch off this button, the Genie’s progress bar will disappear from the game screen.

After every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning symbols disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions are replaced with symbols falling from above. The spins will continue until there are no more winning combinations. All wins are added to the player’s balance at the end of spin. Symbols pay anywhere. All wins are multiplied by your base bet. When winning with multiple symbols, all wins are added to your total win. records.name: PopX
publicIndependentRules: This independent board has six columns, five rows and eleven symbol types. A group of at least eight identical symbols anywhere is a match.
All matching symbols are removed. Remaining symbols fall within their columns, and new symbols fill only the resulting holes.
Each successful cascade raises the confirmed multiplier. The first board without a match crashes the round and pays zero.
The first board resolves when the stake is accepted. Collecting a live round pays its latest confirmed multiplier; a collection at or after a crash pays zero.
The independent operator schedule advances every 1500 milliseconds through 1.15, 1.4, 1.8, 2.4, 3.3, 4.7, 7, 11, 18, 30, 55 and 100 times the stake. Reaching 100 times automatically collects.

The independent first survival probability is 9600/11500. Later survival probabilities are the previous multiplier divided by the next multiplier. Conditional board construction, timing and the 100-times cap are authored choices, not recovered provider probabilities.
This implementation is a single-player round. The provider describes a shared session; shared multiplayer synchronization and any bonus features remain unverified and are not implemented here.
layoutLimitations: Conditional board probabilities, cycle timing, multiplier schedule and 100x cap are independently authored.
Shared multiplayer sessions and any provider bonus mechanics are not implemented.

records.name: Power of Tiger
publicIndependentRules: The observed official demo has three reels, three rows and five active lines. Wild substitutes for regular symbols.
The official public rule applies a randomly selected 5x, 10x, 15x or 20x multiplier when the whole base board is identical or all five active lines win.

The documented random respin selects a regular symbol and a 5x, 10x, 15x or 20x factor. Only that symbol, wilds and blanks appear; selected symbols and wilds lock. A new lock continues the feature; no new locks or a full board ends it. The feature factor applies only to a full board.

Independent operator choices: regular base symbols have 32 tickets each and wild has one; respin triggers on one of 128 tickets; selected symbols and factors are uniform. Each unlocked respin cell has 64 tickets: 8 selected-symbol, 1 wild and 55 blank. Provider probabilities are not established.

Unresolved provider aggregation is not claimed as verified. This independent implementation starts its respin board blank, retains the base award, scores only the final feature board once, and adds that award to the base award. Intermediate feature boards do not create extra payments.

The five-line chart, symbol prizes, all-wild highest-prize treatment, blank initial board, base-plus-feature aggregation and final-grid-only scoring are independently authored. Provider initial holds and award aggregation remain unverified.

The English Help ends the respin on a full selected-symbol and/or-wild board, but its multiplier sentence mentions a full selected-symbol board. This independent implementation counts substituting wilds as filled for that multiplier; the provider wording remains ambiguous.

A maximum of nine respin frames follows from nine lockable cells and immediate stopping on no new locks. One stake is debited; all feature frames resolve on the server as one settled result. STOP only accelerates presentation.

The public 2500x marketing maximum is not used as a hidden payout clamp or claimed as this independent model maximum. Liability reserves the full independently attainable base-plus-feature bound before accepting the stake.
layoutLimitations: The20X sign alone does not establish a feature trigger or probability. The conditional multiplier and respin structure come from the separate official public rules.
The line chart, symbol prizes, probabilities, initial respin holds and base-plus-feature aggregation remain independent or unverified.

The reels will respin if additional symbols of the selected type or Wild symbols land. These symbols remain locked in place, and a new respin is awarded.
The RESPIN feature ends when no additional selected symbols land during a respin or when the entire screen is filled with the selected symbol and/or Wild symbols.

quotes.text: WILD SYMBOL

The WILD symbol substitutes for all other symbols in winning combinations on active paylines. If a WILD symbol does not participate in a win, it remains on the grid and its multiplier increases by +1 on each new spin. When the WILD symbol forms part of a winning combination, the win is multiplied by its current multiplier value.
WILD MULTIPLIER FEATURE

When a WILD symbol appears anywhere on the game grid and does not participate in a winning combination, the WILD symbol remains fixed in its position while a new spin is performed. The selected bet amount is deducted from the player's balance for each new spin. After each new spin in which the WILD symbol does not take part in a winning combination, its multiplier increases by +1 (for example, x2, x3, x4, and so on). Your accumulated WILD Multiplier is linked to your chosen bet value. If you change your bet, the current WILD Multiplier is saved and will reactivate whenever you switch back to that specific betting value. The WILD multiplier increases only when the WILD symbol does not participate in a winning combination. When the WILD symbol forms part of a winning combination, the win is paid and multiplied by the current WILD multiplier value. If a winning combination occurs without the participation of a WILD symbol, that win is paid normally. (According to the paytable). A new spin then follows, and the WILD multiplier increases if the WILD symbol again does not form part of a winning combination. Multiple WILD symbols may appear on the game grid at the same time. Any WILD symbol that participates in a winning combination is removed from the grid. WILD symbols that do not participate remain in place, and their multipliers increase by +1 on each new spin in which they do not form part of a winning combination.

By activating this feature, the bet amount is multiplied by 5, and each spin is played with this increased bet amount. When this bet is active, at least one 5X WILD symbol is guaranteed to appear on the very first spin. If this WILD symbol does not participate in a winning combination, its multiplier will increase by +1. If the same WILD symbol still does not participate in a winning combination on the next spin, its multiplier will increase by another +1, and so on, until that WILD symbol participates in a winning combination. During each new spin, if a new WILD symbol appears, its multiplier will always start at 5X, and the same rule described above will apply to it as well.If 2 WILD symbols participate in a winning combination, their multipliers are added together, and the payout for the winning line is calculated using the combined multiplier. The WILD symbol(s) that participate in a winning combination are removed from the game board. However, if there is another WILD symbol on the board that does not participate in a winning combination, it will remain on the game board. If the player stops playing or changes the bet, any existing WILD symbol or symbols and their multipliers from the already played ANTE BET will be saved. When the player returns to that specific ANTE BET, the saved WILD symbol or symbols will still be present in the game with their accumulated multipliers.The WILD symbol and its multiplier are saved only for the specific fixed ANTE BET on which they were accumulated. When the bet is changed, that WILD symbol and its multiplier will not carry over to another ANTE BET selection. The player can stop playing with ANTE BET at any time by pressing the Disable button. In this case, the base bet amount will return to the value it had before ANTE BET was activated.

quotes.text: X2 - GAMBLE FEATURE

In the game, players have the opportunity to double their winnings with the X2 Gamble Feature. After a winning spin, players can access the Gamble round by clicking the “X2” button. Once the gamble screen appears, a card in the middle of the screen will flash red and black while face down, indicating that the gamble feature is active. To double their winnings, players must correctly guess the color of the card that will be revealed next. If they succeed, their winnings will be doubled. However if the guess incorrectly, their original win will be lost. At any point, players can use the “Take Win” button to collect their winnings and add them to their main balance.
Gamble your winnings

When you hit a winning combination, you have three options to credit the win amount to your balance: you can start a new spin by clicking the spin button, Use the take win button to transfer the win to your balance, or use the X2 Double up feature button and clickt take win. If you are playing in AutoPlay mode, all wins are automatically transferred to your balance.

Wild substitutes for any regular symbol. Three Wilds pay their observed own prize of 100 times the line stake.

This independent model gives each eligible cell 288 regular-symbol tickets and one wild ticket; regular symbols share those tickets equally. Multiplier values are equally likely.
Symbol prizes follow the publicly observed DEMO paytable. Paylines and probabilities are independently authored; certified provider RTP is not reproduced.
The help advertises 375x maximum, but its displayed wild prize combined with 5x permits a 500x independent bound. Unverified provider restrictions are not replaced with a hidden payout clamp.
The official public page advertises X2: guess the color of a flashing card to double a winning award, or collect it.
Choose holdWin before the spin to retain a winning award for red/black X2 or immediate collection. No additional stake is debited.

This independent implementation uses equally likely red/black cards and at most three attempts. The final success collects automatically. These probabilities, attempt limit and pre-spin hold control are operator choices; provider equivalence is not established.
layoutLimitations: The observed own wild prize plus 5x permits a 500x independent base bound, while help advertises 375x; provider award restrictions are unverified.
The provider payline chart and probabilities are unverified. X2 uses independently fair colors, a pre-spin hold control and an independent three-attempt limit.

quotes.text: Gamble your winnings

When you hit a winning combination, you have three options to credit the win amount to your balance: you can start a new spin by clicking the spin button, Use the take win button to transfer the win to your balance, or use the X2 Double up feature button and clickt take win. If you are playing in AutoPlay mode, all wins are automatically transferred to your balance.
X2 - GAMBLE FEATURE

In the game, players have the opportunity to double their winnings with the X2 Gamble Feature. After a winning spin, players can access the Gamble round by clicking the “X2” button. Once the gamble screen appears, a card in the middle of the screen will flash red and black while face down, indicating that the gamble feature is active. To double their winnings, players must correctly guess the color of the card that will be revealed next. If they succeed, their winnings will be doubled. However if the guess incorrectly, their original win will be lost. At any point, players can use the “Take Win” button to collect their winnings and add them to their main balance.

records.name: Coins Of Atlantis
publicIndependentRules: The observed official entry shows five reels and four rows. This independent model uses an authored line chart; the exact provider chart and count remain unverified.

Documented wilds on reels2–4 expand when used in a winning combination. This implementation counts landed coins before that one-pass regular-spin wild expansion; provider coin/expansion order is unverified.

Five or more landed coins trigger3respins. Initial coins lock; only empty cells respin. A new coin resets the allowance to3. A +1RESPIN coin changes the persistent reset allowance to4, including later resets.
Regular coin values are1x through10x,15x or20x; MINI is25x and MAJOR is50x of the accepted total bet. A +1RESPIN coin carries one of the regular values.

The feature ends after the current3-or4 consecutive empty respins or a full board. At the end all coin values add; a full board doubles that coin sum. Intermediate boards do not create separate payments.

The feature has a finite capacity-based bound: each successful reset locks at least one new cell; between locks at most4respins occur. With20cells and at least5initial coins, at most60respin frames are possible.

This independently authored aggregation retains the regular-spin award and adds the final coin feature award once. Provider base-plus-feature aggregation and coin/expansion ordering remain unverified.
MEGA/GRAND multi-coin jackpot restrictions, buy bonus and ANTE are not implemented. The provider2500x marketing maximum does not establish a hidden clamp for this independent model.

Base symbols receive32tickets each, eligible wilds one, regular coins16, MINI2 and MAJOR1. Each empty feature cell has64tickets:8regular-coin,1MINI,1MAJOR,1+1RESPIN and53blank. Regular coin values are uniform. These probabilities, original symbol prizes and line chart are operator choices, not provider mathematics.
layoutLimitations: The exact provider line chart and count remain unverified.
MEGA/GRAND jackpot grouping, buy/ANTE features, provider probabilities and base/feature ordering remain unimplemented or unverified.

quotes.text: The main feature of this slot is collecting Coins to trigger Respins and aiming to land high-value Jackpot Coins for bigger wins. 3 Respins are triggered when 5 or more Coins of any value land anywhere on the board during the base game. All landed Coins remain locked in their positions while the empty cells Respin. If one or more new Coin symbols land in any empty position, the remaining Respins are reset back to 3. Respins end when no Coin lands during 3 consecutive Respins or when the entire board is filled with Coin symbols. If the board becomes fully filled with Coins, the total win is multiplied by X2. After the Respins finish, all Coin values are added together to determine the total Respin win.

records.name: Multi Hot Wild Ways
publicIndependentRules: The observed official demo has three reels and three rows, a left multiplier reel, and an explicit27WAYS label. All20 recorded result grids contain nine symbols.

The official public rule pays matching symbols from consecutive reels beginning at the leftmost reel. Selecting one row from each of three reels gives27 possible ways. Wild substitutes for regular symbols.

This independent model evaluates each of the27 row combinations exactly once. A matching three-symbol way pays floor(total stake × the authored symbol prize /27); way awards add, then the server multiplier applies.
An all-wild way receives the highest eligible regular-symbol award once. No vertical wild expansion is inferred for this title.

The official English Help lists five possible factors: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x and 5x. All five also occurred in recorded public results. This independent implementation gives them equal probability; the provider distribution remains unverified.

Symbol prizes, total-stake/27 award allocation, all-wild treatment and per-cell ticket probabilities are operator choices. The static Help document does not establish the complete provider award basis, symbol-ID mapping or probabilities.

The raw provider LinePlay value1 is a betting field. It is not treated as one payline, nor as evidence of27 fixed paylines. Gamble and complete provider bonus behavior remain unimplemented or unverified.
layoutLimitations: Provider LinePlay1 is a betting field, not a payline count.
The provider symbol-ID mapping, award basis, probabilities and full bonus behavior remain unverified.27-way allocation and awards are independently authored.

These combinations are paid from left to right on adjacent reels, beginning with the leftmost reel. Symbols in different positions on the same reel will also count as part of the same combination. The Wild symbol substitutes for all other symbols on the 27 Ways to Pay, from left to right, if it can create a winning combination. Total winnings from a single spin are multiplied by the Multiplier Reel multiplier to determine the final Total Win.

records.name: Chicken Highway
publicIndependentRules: Chicken Highway is a horizontal road-crossing game. The official public presentation source supplies25 EASY lanes ending20x,23 MEDIUM lanes ending1000x and19 HARD lanes ending10000x. These are documented display values, not observed wins at every lane.

START accepts one stake and attempts the first crossing. A safe first EASY crossing offers CASHOUT at1.02x. GO attempts the next lane without another debit; CASHOUT collects the confirmed current multiplier. A collision loses the uncollected stake and award. The final successful lane automatically collects in this independent implementation.

Choose difficulty before starting. Mode and accepted stake remain fixed while the server round is active. Payouts use integer minor units and floor after multiplication; the browser cannot choose the outcome or supply a balance.

Independent operator probabilities use9480/first-multiplier survival, then previous-multiplier/next-multiplier conditional survival. Those authored probabilities are not recovered provider probabilities and do not reproduce the official Help97% RTP claim.

The official Help describes automatic runs with a selected cashout step and cashout after a disconnection longer than8seconds. These provider-specific autoplay and connection policies are not implemented; the retained server expiry/recovery policy still applies.
The earlier visual reading of EASY lane8 as1.54 was inaccurate; the public presentation source specifies1.55. Full artwork, sound, probability and provider equivalence remain unverified.
layoutLimitations: The directly played first EASY crossing does not prove all future lane outcomes or other difficulties.
Provider survival probabilities, full visual/audio parity, native autoplay and8second-disconnection cashout remain unverified or unimplemented.

In the game, players have the opportunity to double their winnings with the X2 Gamble Feature. After a winning spin, players can access the Gamble round by clicking the “X2” button. Once the gamble screen appears, a card in the middle of the screen will flash red and black while face down, indicating that the gamble feature is active. To double their winnings, players must correctly guess the color of the card that will be revealed next. If they succeed, their winnings will be doubled. However if the guess incorrectly, their original win will be lost. At any point, players can use the “Take Win” button to collect their winnings and add them to their main balance. Double up limit :
Gamble your winnings

When you hit a winning combination, you have three options to credit the win amount to your balance: you can start a new spin by clicking the spin button, Use the take win button to transfer the win to your balance, or use the X2 Double up feature button and clickt take win. If you are playing in AutoPlay mode, all wins are automatically transferred to your balance.

records.name: Balloon
publicIndependentRules: This original ten-step ladder attempts the first step on Play. The first step can fail.
Each successful step offers Collect. A failed step forfeits all uncollected value.
First-step survival is return basis points divided by the first multiplier. Later conditional survival is previous multiplier divided by next multiplier.
Visual step choices do not change probabilities. The final successful step collects automatically.
layoutLimitations: Official geometry, visual behaviour, audio and complete game mechanics remain unverified.

records.name: Plinko X
publicIndependentRules: The observed non-Classic Plinko X LOW board has16 peg rows and17 buckets. LOW prizes are20,10,5,2,1.5,1.3,1.1,0.8,0.5,0.8,1.1,1.3,1.5,2,5,10,20 times the per-ball stake. The static legend shows pink1x, yellow5x and blue10x balls.

A subsequent read-only official DEMO inspection of rendered bucket captions verifies all17 MEDIUM and HIGH prizes. Their edge buckets are100x and1000x; the static10x color factor permits1000x and10000x maximum awards. These two risk tables were displayed and screenshotted without any additional wager; their outcomes were not sampled.

Select1,5,10 or25 balls. The accepted stake is the TOTAL batch stake; it must split exactly into equal whole-ETB per-ball stakes of at least1ETB. The displayed total is per-ball stake times ball amount. One request debits and reserves that total once, and credits the sum of completed ball awards once.

Each independent ball takes16 fair left/right turns. The bucket index is the number of right turns. The server independently chooses pink/yellow/blue using authored995/4/1 tickets, then pays floor(per-ball stake × bucket multiplier × ball multiplier). These operator choices are not verified provider probabilities or native color-selection semantics.

The risk-specific independent upper bounds are200xTOTAL for LOW,1000xTOTAL for MEDIUM and10000xTOTAL for HIGH. Every ball result is settled by the server before animation; STOP changes presentation only. Client-supplied colors, paths, prizes and balances are rejected.

Twenty official LOW single-ball rounds were observed, including an effective11x award. Native5/10/25-ball accounting, medium/high outcomes, recovery, exact artwork/audio and full provider parity were not established. This batch accounting contract is independently authored and explicitly separate from those observations.
layoutLimitations: All three17-bucket tables are verified from rendered captions/screenshots. Only LOW single-ball outcomes were directly played; Medium/High outcomes remain unobserved.
Paths, color selection and atomic total-stake batch settlement are independent operator choices; native multi-ball accounting was not played.
Provider probabilities, exact artwork/audio, recovery and complete parity remain unverified.

quotes.text: Previous OTHER RULES 09 Game Objective: The goal is to win money by dropping Plinko X balls and waiting for them to randomly land on a multiplier slot at the bottom of the board. Fair Play: The speed, skill, or decision of the player does not influence or increase the chances of winning or define the outcome of the game. Outcomes are determined by a Random Number Generator (RNG). Bet Deduction: Each ball dropped will deduct its corresponding bet amount individually from your balance. For example, if the bet size is 1 DMO each ball dropped will cost 1 DMO from your balance. Malfunction Policy: In the event of a malfunction, all plays and payouts are void. All unfinished rounds will be terminated. If a disconnection occurs or the game is reloaded, all active bets and rounds will complete automatically, with winnings credited to your balance. Auto Play will be deactivated after disconnection. Variations in connection speed or device processing capabilities may impact, or appear to impact, overall game performance. RTP Information: The RTP is based on theoretical calculations and is not influenced by player behavior. It reflects long-term returns under standard betting conditions.The overall theoretical RTP (Return to Player) of this game is LOW: 97,00% MEDIUM: 97.00% HIGH: 97.00% LOW B+: 97.02% MEDIUM B+: 97.03% HIGH B+: 97.01% The current version of the game is Game Version v1.1.0 ABOUT THE GAME 01 “Plinko X” is an exciting Plinko-style game where players place bets, and colorful balls drop from the top of a pyramid, bouncing through random paths before landing on multipliers at the bottom. Each multiplier determines the payout for that round. During the game, the panel on the left displays the multipliers won in each ball drop. The player's speed or skill does not influence or increase the chances of winning or determine the game outcome. Each ball dropped individually deducts the bet amount from your balance. KEY FEATURE: Colorful balls: With each click, one ball (1x, 5x, or10x) is randomly selected to drop onto the pyramid. Higher-value balls lead to bigger winnings at the end. Game Version: Choose from three volatility levels—Low, Medium, or High—offering different multiplier ranges. Quick Play: Drop 25 balls at once with a single click for faster gameplay. B+ Features: For 50% extra cost (not included in payouts), this feature increases the chance of landing higher-value balls (5x and 10x). Maximum payout potential is 10,000x when playing the High volatility version. This is achievable if a 10x ball lands in the 1,000x slot at the base of the pyramid, with this result occurring approximately once every 4,802,650 rounds. quotes.text: In Multi Hot Ways, players have the opportunity to double their winnings with the X2 Gamble Feature. After a winning spin, players can access the Gamble round by clicking the "X2" button. Once the gamble screen appears, a card in the middle of the screen will flash red and black while face down, indicating that the gamble feature is active. records.name: Wheel Of Destiny
publicIndependentRules: The public Wheel Of Destiny presentation defines50 main-ring display segments, separately from the betting grid. The grid has3x,4x,8x,9.6x,12x,16x,24x,48x and BONUS. The number of selectable fields is not the wheel segment count.

Allocate the TOTAL accepted stake across one or more regular fields. Every selected field must contain a canonical whole-ETB amount of at least1ETB, fields must be unique, and the selected amounts must sum exactly to the accepted total. Omitting bets selects3x for the whole total by default.

One server result selects one field. A matching regular field returns its allocated stake times its gross multiplier, including the stake. Unmatched allocations lose. One accepted total is debited, the maximum possible matching allocation award is reserved, and one aggregate payout is settled. Official round6 directly confirmed1DMO on3x returning3DMO.

The independent result uses50 equally weighted display-segment tickets. This is an operator probability choice, not an inference about provider RNG from the public ring. The96% expectation applies only to this regular-eight-field subset, not the complete game or provider.

BONUS is visibly a ninth betting field with up to1200x advertised, and a resultSymbol8/coefficient50 was observed when no bonus stake was selected. Its complete stake, bonus-wheel and continuation rules remain under review; BONUS betting is unavailable and no paid bonus outcome is simulated.

The server resolves the full regular round before animation. STOP only presents that immutable receipt faster. All arithmetic uses integer minor units; multiple selections do not create multiple wallet debits.
layoutLimitations: Uniform50 outcome tickets are independent operator probabilities, not inferred provider probabilities.

quotes.text: The player has the option to select the bet multiplier. Depending on the selected bet, playing with B+ will always cost the player an extra 25% of their total bet. The added B+ value will not be taken into consideration when paying out on symbols, either in the basic or bonus game. The B+ feature allows players to collect scatters received only during the base game. If a player collects 100 scatters during the same round, the player will trigger a free bonus game. B+ bet also has the ‘Risk’ game feature, which means that as soon as a player reaches 10% of the progress bar, they can play the ‘Risk’ game. The Risk game chance depends on the percentage of the progress bar. When the Risk game is triggered, a wheel appears on the screen. Players can spin the wheel and if they hit a win, they will be awarded a Bonus game. If they hit a ‘lose’ they will return to the base game. After spinning the Risk game wheel, whether the player wins or loses, the progress bar will be reset.The cost of a Risk game spin is the same as the bet amount. If a player does not have enough money in their account, an error pop-up will appear asking them to add funds. After spinning the Risk game wheel, if the player loses, they will receive one extra spin in the base game. If the player wins the Risk game spin, they will receive a bonus winning spin in the base game. If a player lands 4 or more scatters during the base game at the same time, the Genies progress bar will increase to 100% and the player will play 2 bonus games. The first will start automatically and after this, the second game begins. By default, at the start of the game, the B+ button is always activated. If you choose to switch off this button, the Genie’s progress bar will disappear from the game screen.

The bonus game feature triggers when 4 or more scatter symbols land anywhere on the screen. The round starts with 10 free spins. Whenever 3 or more scatter symbols land during the free spins round, 5 additional free spins are awarded. During the bonus round, players can receive extra multiplier symbols that can land anywhere on the screen. Multiplier symbols are present on the reels only during the bonus game and they remain on the screen until the end of the current spin. Whenever a multiplier symbol lands, it will take a random value of:2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, 6X, 7X, 8X, 9X, 10X, 12X, 15X, 18X, 20X, 25X, 30X, 40X, 50X, 60X, 80X, 90X or 100X. When the spin ends, the value of all multiplier symbols on the screen are added together and the total win of that round is multiplied by the final value.

The B+ feature allows players to collect scatters received only during the base game. If a player collects 100 scatters during the same round, the player will trigger a free bonus game. B+ bet also has the ‘Risk’ game feature, which means that as soon as a player reaches 10% of the progress bar, they can play the ‘Risk’ game. The Risk game chance depends on the percentage of the progress bar. When the Risk game is triggered, a wheel appears on the screen. Players can spin the wheel and if they hit a win, they will be awarded a Bonus game. If they hit a ‘lose’ they will return to the base game. After spinning the Risk game wheel, whether the player wins or loses, the progress bar will be reset.The cost of a Risk game spin is the same as the bet amount. If a player does not have enough money in their account, an error pop-up will appear asking them to add funds. After spinning the Risk game wheel, if the player loses, they will receive one extra spin in the base game. If the player wins the Risk game spin, they will receive a bonus winning spin in the base game. If a player lands 4 or more scatters during the base game at the same time, the Genies progress bar will increase to 100% and the player will play 2 bonus games. The first will start automatically and after this, the second game begins. By default, at the start of the game, the B+ button is always activated. If you choose to switch off this button, the Genie’s progress bar will disappear from the game screen.

quotes.text: "Wild & Gods" is a thrilling slot game from Smartsoft Gaming, set in the enchanting realm of ancient Greek gods. With its stunning visuals, smooth animations, and engaging mechanics, it delivers an extraordinary gaming adventure. Get ready for two exciting bonus features that offer the chance for big wins, making your gameplay experience even more enjoyable.

This game offers two exciting bonuses: Zeus and Poseidon Bonuses. In both, players get 3 free spins with a chance to earn extra spins if a special symbol lands on the last reel during the bonus round. To trigger either bonus, you need to catch Bonus Scatter symbols on the middle 3rd reel.The key feature of these bonuses is the fixed Wild reel during free spins, which remains in place until the bonus ends. In Zeus Bonus, Wild reels start on the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd reels, while in Poseidon Bonus, they start on the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th reels. The number of Wild reels depends on the number of Bonus Scatters collected during the base game. One scatter guarantees one Wild reel, two guarantee two Wild reels, and a full reel of scatters guarantees three Wild reels.During the bonus round, you might land an Extra Spin symbol on the last reel, adding an extra spin to your bonus round.This game also offers a Bonus Buy feature, allowing players to purchase their preferred bonus round immediately. Simply tap the Bonus Buy button and select the desired Bonus Buy price. You can choose between Zeus Bonus (costing x200 times your bet) and Poseidon Bonus (costing x150 times your bet). This feature ensures all three reels turn wild during bonus spins.

quotes.text: Book symbol plays as a wild and 4+ scatters will trigger bonus round.

Prizes are awarded for matching combinations of symbols. Combinations must appear from left to right on a line, except for scatters. Only the highest win on each line and for each scatter combination is paid. Scatter wins and line wins are combined. The paytable displays prizes for the currently selected bet amount. Book Scatter symbols can substitute any paying symbol during the game

4 or more book scatters on the screen trigger 10 free games with a special expanding symbol. The special expanding symbol cannot be substituted by a scatter symbol during Free games. One special expanding symbol is randomly selected at the start of the Free games. During Free Games and after the payout of regular symbols, the special symbol may expand to cover 3 positions on the reel and pays like the regular symbol, even on non-adjacent positions and on all lines played (expanding is only triggered if enough symbols for a win are present). Every time a player hits 3 or more Book scatter symbols during Free games, they will win an extra 10 Free spins, and the expanding bonus symbol will remain the same. Players can use the Buy Bonus Feature to buy the Free Games Round at a specified price.

The B+ feature lets players accumulate scatters exclusively during the base game. Upon collecting 100 scatters at a specific bet amount, players automatically trigger a free bonus game. The B+ feature also introduces the "Bonus Gamble" option. When the B+ Progress Bar reaches 10%, players can engage in the Gamble game. The outcome, whether a win or lose, is determined by the progress bar percentage.

The cost of a Bonus Risk game spin aligns with the bet amount used to accumulate Progress Bar percentages. If a player lacks sufficient funds, an error pop-up prompts them to add funds. Losing in the Bonus Risk game grants an extra spin in the base game, while winning rewards players with a bonus-winning spin. Landing 4+ Scatters during the base game triggers the bonus game immediately — it does not add to the B+ Progress Bar. The Progress Bar fills separately from base game events and, at 100%, triggers its own single bonus game.
